topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 35 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (delegateinterface, adminable, delegatorinterface). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
